decision: Retain notification simplification: one synchronization owner, one Python completion ticket per batch, and two delivery operations. Observer mean gains repeat; no universal latency or contention improvement is claimed.

removed: SDK notification Condition and enqueue/drain wakeups with no production waiters
Native queue manual next/complete and separate target methods
preserved: FIFO delivery and committing-caller target boundaries
Recursive entry-tail capture and ContextVar delivery

build_control.method: Production uv/maturin release wheel with unchanged Cargo.lock, features and release profile; frozen control extension from the prior matched production build. SDK/native adapter changes are bundled in one wheel.

environment.gc: enabled; collected before each measured batch
environment.io: warm OS page cache; no fsync; final buffer drain included
environment.memory: fresh-process Linux RSS, including native allocations

initial_full_run.failure: Unchanged artifact exact access-time assertion; five isolated before and five isolated after trials passed; subsequent full suite passed. No artifact source was modified.

limitations: Backend hundred-metric mean improves 5.58% then 3.25%; ten-rule mean improves 3.42% then 1.52%. Exact effect size varies.
Default/changing/NumPy local means change +0.15%/-1.03%/+1.32% in the full campaign; no demonstrated local-path speedup.
Small-record/span means change +1.18%/+2.10% initially and +0.04%/-0.18% in confirmation; no span speedup claim.
Reader-contention means change -6.38% then +2.09%, with high variation; no contention improvement claim.
Backend p99 improves initially but worsens in confirmation; rule p99 worsens in both. Tail latency is not uniformly improved.
SDK write/lifecycle locks, dynamic compatibility hooks, observer projections and the Viewer cache mutex remain.
